market_pulse.narrative: Regulators and operators are facing heightened scrutiny and legal challenges around prediction markets, with lawsuits, lobbying efforts, and market impacts being reported across multiple jurisdictions.

Operators are securing new licences and launching products in emerging markets such as Rwanda, Canada (Alberta), Mauritius, Goa, and Germany, while existing operators expand partnerships to broaden distribution.
A wave of executive appointments, board‑level discussions and M&A hints signal a focus on governance structures and strategic leadership to navigate tightening margins and regulatory pressure.
New advisory committees, anonymity‑focused tools and public policy commentary highlight an industry‑wide push to strengthen responsible gambling and reduce stigma for harmed players.
Strong earnings reports, integration plans and acquisition rumours illustrate ongoing consolidation and the financial health of major operators.
